record.title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Performance and Marking
record.description:
Specifies minimum performance, construction, inspection, and marking requirements for industrial safety helmets intended to protect workers from falling objects and incidental impact in routine industrial and construction environments.

Applies to industrial safety helmets supplied for general workplace use; excludes helmets specifically designed for high-voltage electrical insulation, firefighting, sports, and motorcycling.

Key requirements: Shell material shall maintain structural integrity after impact testing.; Helmet suspension shall retain the shell and maintain clearance from the headform.; Chin-strap attachment, where provided, shall meet the specified retention performance.; Manufacturer shall control dimensions, materials, and production consistency.

Testing requirements: Impact attenuation test using specified impact energies and headform configuration.; Penetration resistance test using a controlled striker.; Retention-system performance test where a retention system is supplied.; Environmental conditioning before selected performance tests.

Documentation required: Product specification sheet.; Bill of materials or material declaration.; Routine production inspection record.; Relevant laboratory test report.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer or responsible brand identification.; Model or product identification.; Standard number: IS DEMO 1001:2026.; Manufacturing batch or traceability mark.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the referenced product control order is in force; otherwise this standard may be used for voluntary product conformity claims.
